name: USB-A socket
summary: The full-size rectangular USB port. Needs a 13 x 6 mm panel slot.
source: The USB Type-A plug shell is 12.0 x 4.5 mm, which is fixed by the USB specification. The 13.0 x 6.0 mm cutout here is the usual working opening: it clears the shell plus the moulded strain relief on a typical cable. Socket bodies vary a lot between manufacturers, so check yours before cutting a panel.

keepouts.label: Room for the plug and cable

electrical.note: USB 2.0 ports supply 500 mA, USB 3.0 ports 900 mA, unless the host negotiates more.
